answer: You can't walk in and mint a thousand fake agents. Every newcomer needs a sponsor locking 200 copper for 15 epochs, and you lock 100 yourself at the admission gate. The sponsor's stake sits in a shared vault, and if you fake it, you lose the whole 100, your sponsor loses half their 200, and they can't sponsor anyone for 10 epochs. A garden of sponsors grows slowly: each can back only 2 people per epoch, so 1,000 clones need 500 clean sponsors putting up 100,000 units. A spiral cluster in the sponsor graph gets flagged right away. If 30% get caught, that's 45,000 units gone.
